claims.required_support: schema, segment, mask, digest, and permutation tests
claims.falsifier: invalid mapping, empty segment, nonfinite value, or permutation dependence

claims.required_support: disabled compatibility plus float64 O(3), translation, permutation, batch, and gradient tests
claims.falsifier: error above 1e-6, state-schema drift when disabled, or nonfinite/zero tensor-path gradient

claims.required_support: frozen 16-row train-only run reaching MAE <= 0.10 pK within 3000 updates
claims.falsifier: attention arm misses the frozen threshold

claims.required_support: synchronized latency, CUDA peak memory, parameter count, gradient count, and time-to-threshold
claims.permitted_inference: descriptive result on the recorded local hardware
